entries.2f144384239af3ed: A trading company that handles goods and services in five fields: ICT, electronics and devices, food, steel, materials and plants, and vehicles and aerospace.
entries.3463ad4b5ca26f89: This business provides a wide range of products, including electronic components and materials, semiconductor and liquid crystal manufacturing equipment, and electronics-related materials and auxiliary materials, together with services including development and proposals. It also handles mobile communication terminals and operates mobile internet systems. The main affiliates are Kanematsu Communications, Ltd. and Kanematsu Future Tech Solutions Co., Ltd., and there are 27 consolidated subsidiaries (as of March 31, 2026). The businesses listed are the Mobile Business, the Electronic Equipment and Materials Business, and the Semiconductor Components and Manufacturing Equipment Business. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue was ¥306,895 million (prior year: ¥271,373 million) and profit attributable to owners of the parent was ¥10,916 million (prior year: ¥7,031 million), with the Mobile Business and the Electronic Equipment and Materials Business performing well.

entries.666fb48d9459991c: This business handles domestic and trade transactions in steel products in general, including various steel plates, bar and wire rods, steel pipes and stainless steel products, as well as various plants and infrastructure projects for overseas customers, and transactions in petroleum products, liquefied petroleum gas, biomass fuels, functional chemicals and functional foods, and pharmaceutical and agrochemical intermediates. It also engages in ground improvement, timber processing, environment-related business and emissions-rights-related business. The main affiliates are Kanematsu Chemical Co., Ltd., Kanematsu Petro Co., Ltd. and Kanematsu Sustec Corporation, and there are 15 consolidated subsidiaries and 3 equity-method affiliates (as of March 31, 2026). Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥169,386 million (prior year: ¥198,408 million) and profit attributable to owners of the parent was ¥2,545 million (prior year: ¥4,015 million). Revenue decreased, owing to weak performance in the energy business and a reactionary decline in the plant business, which had performed well in the previous fiscal year.

entries.b6651b53ae421051: It is a business that, based on IT (information and communication technology), provides design, construction and operation services for corporate information systems and system consulting, and sells, leases, maintains, develops and manufactures IT system products and software, and also provides worker dispatch services. Its main affiliate is Kanematsu Electronics Ltd., and its equity-method affiliate is Global Security Expert Co., Ltd. It has 7 consolidated subsidiaries and 1 equity-method affiliate (as of March 31, 2026). Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥110,771 million (prior year: ¥99,528 million), and profit attributable to owners of the parent was ¥10,293 million (prior year: ¥9,970 million). Demand was strong for storage and servers for the manufacturing sector and networks for the distribution sector, as well as for services and security.

entries.bdec1dd1a4832e4a: It is a business centered on the sale and trading of aircraft, helicopters, space and satellite-related products, defense-related products, automobiles and motorcycles, machine tools and industrial machinery, industrial vehicles, and related products, and it also proposes products and services that increase value tailored to demand and use. Its main affiliates are Kanematsu KGK Corporation and Kanematsu Aerospace Corporation, and it has 23 consolidated subsidiaries and 1 equity-method affiliate (as of March 31, 2026). Its businesses are listed as the Machine Tools and Industrial Machinery Business, the Aerospace Business, and the Vehicles and Automotive Components Business. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥119,845 million (prior year: ¥121,912 million), and profit attributable to owners of the parent was ¥3,548 million (prior year: ¥3,184 million). Revenue declined due to a reactionary decrease in transactions for engine parts for aircraft and naval vessels, which had been strong in the prior year, but transactions for aircraft airframe parts were strong.

entries.c1f4c19b1b9ad3ed: This business provides a range of products, including prepared foods, processed fruit and vegetable products, processed agricultural products, plant-based meat, alcoholic beverages, beverage ingredients, livestock and marine products, wheat, rice, soybeans, feed ingredients and pet food, on an integrated basis from securing stable raw materials to high value-added products. The main affiliates are Kanematsu Foods Co., Ltd. and Kanematsu Agritech Co., Ltd., and there are 10 consolidated subsidiaries and 15 equity-method affiliates (as of March 31, 2026). The businesses listed are the Food Business, the Livestock Business and the Food Grain Business. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue was ¥358,866 million (prior year: ¥357,536 million) and profit attributable to owners of the parent was ¥5,374 million (prior year: ¥3,063 million), with the Livestock Business performing well. It is the reportable segment with the largest revenue from external customers.
